http
— HTTP modules
¶
Source code:
Lib/http/__init__.py
http
is a package that collects several modules for working with the
HyperText Transfer Protocol:
http.client
is a low-level HTTP protocol client; for high-level URL
opening use
urllib.request
http.server
contains basic HTTP server classes based on
socketserver
http.cookies
has utilities for implementing state management with cookies
http.cookiejar
provides persistence of cookies
The
http
module also defines the following enums that help you work with http related code:
class
http.

http.HTTPStatus.OK
is also available as
